title: companion-click.v1
description: One JSON file per button click, filed by the app into the firstmate inbox. draft_text is the exact text Alan approved, when the click carries one. nudges (optional) names the idempotency_key of an earlier click that still waits for firstmate: the bridge files a fresh note pointing at it (a new wake), or answers 'already acknowledged'. The app sends it with action_id <original action_id>.nudge.
